waivers.reason: 4 copper layers: the sponsorship announcement (17 Nov 2026) allows up to 200 x 200 mm and up to 4 layers. In1.Cu is an unbroken GND plane, In2.Cu carries slow signals and a GND fill.
Driver-to-gate path U1 pin 20 -> R5 -> Q1 gate is 21.3 mm (TG 5.5 + TG_G 15.8). The remaining 12.7 mm is the stub to test point TP9, which carries no gate current.
VIN_IC is VIN behind R21 (4.7 ohm). It is measured at C26 pad 1 or R21 pad 2; a test point would change the schematic and BOM after the feedback round.
Q2 tab (pad 5) is the switch node. Vias would put SW copper on the inner and bottom layers; the tab cools through the 1.2 cm2 SW pour on F.Cu and the source pins through 8 GND vias to the planes.
Q3 (reverse-polarity MOSFET) loses about 0.1 W (4 mOhm at 5.3 A); the VIN_RTN pour of 1.2 cm2 on F.Cu is enough. Its source pins have 18 GND vias.
